prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Claimant reports being struck while stopped at a marked space by a vehicle reversing out of an adjacent stall. Both drivers exchanged information at the scene. Police were not called. Photos of both vehicles requested from claimant.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says they prefer to handle the claim directly. Claimant describes neck and back strain beginning later the same day with stiffness and pain when turning the head. Claimant has not yet seen a physician. Advised claimant of the medical evaluation option and the process for submitting medical bills.

Entry 3: Received photos from claimant showing rear bumper damage and a cracked tail light lens on the insured's vehicle. Reviewed the scene description against the insured's statement, which is consistent on the point of impact. Insured states the other vehicle was reversing at low speed. Estimate requested from the body shop of the insured's choice.

Entry 4: Claimant reports they visited an urgent care clinic and was diagnosed with a cervical neck strain and a lumbar back strain. Claimant was given a muscle relaxant and advised to rest and apply heat. Claimant has provided the visit summary and is awaiting the itemized bill. Claimant states they have missed two days of work and is reviewing the wage loss documentation required.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Claimant is still experiencing neck and back discomfort but reports improvement. Physical therapy has been recommended by the clinic and claimant is considering scheduling sessions. Explained the process for submitting medical records and wage verification. Claimant indicated they will send documents within the next week. File remains open pending medical and repair records.
